viewportNote: Chromium emulation only; iOS Safari was not tested

notCaptured.reason: No WebKit or iOS device in the build environment. Every "390x844" image is Chromium with touch emulation, not iOS Safari.

notCaptured.item: Real microphone, dictation and live voice in use
notCaptured.reason: No audio hardware; only the buttons and idle states are shown. Voice is covered by simulated-audio suites, not by these images.

notCaptured.item: Hosted preview signed in / Sample Office on the hosted preview
notCaptured.reason: The hosted preview cannot sign in (its API base is a placeholder); that is why this gallery exists. Every image here is a local capture.

notCaptured.item: Real Grant office data, real Google calendar, real Telegram/Slack
notCaptured.reason: Production access is forbidden for this task. Data is synthetic rows in an isolated replica.

notCaptured.item: Event editor over the populated replica
notCaptured.reason: The populated run did not open the editor (the capture failed and is not included). The editor is shown from the stand-in office instead.

notCaptured.item: Task, contact and document record sheets on the stand-in office; Attention page
notCaptured.reason: The stand-in office has no such records, and the Attention page did not open in the lab. The record sheets are shown from the populated replica.

notCaptured.item: Module tint / layouts popovers and sticky notes on a phone
notCaptured.reason: Not offered on a phone by design (arrangement controls are off there). Desktop captures included.

Team HQ is a fixed-viewport canvas (ADR-0072): the page itself does not scroll, lists scroll inside their module or sheet. Captures are viewport images; lists are shown through the maximised module views. Settings panes taller than a phone screen are cut at the viewport.
Not part of the page. The in-page undo bar and dialogs are captured.

notCaptured.item: Palette matrix beyond Settings and the dashboard
notCaptured.reason: Other looks (Slate & Silver, Forest & Brass, Warm Graphite) are captured for the dashboard and Settings only, as asked, to avoid a needless full matrix.
